home.title: Villa Madau Hotel – Pula, Sardinia
home.description: Boutique Hotel in the heart of Pula's historic centre, Sardinia. Rooms with balcony, authentic Sardinian cuisine, free WiFi and parking. Steps away from the ancient ruins of Nora and the crystal-clear beaches of southern Sardinia.
home.ogDescription: Boutique Hotel in the historic centre of Pula, Sardinia. Rooms with balcony, Sardinian cuisine, free WiFi and parking. Near Nora and the southern beaches.
home.ogAlt: Villa Madau Hotel in Pula – exterior view

hotel.title: The Hotel
hotel.description: Villa Madau is a small boutique hotel tucked away in the historic centre of Pula, Sardinia. Ten suites, an inner garden, a terrace, and breakfast in the piazza: authentic village life.
hotel.ogTitle: The Hotel | Villa Madau – Pula, Sardinia
hotel.ogDescription: Boutique hotel in the historic centre of Pula. Ten suites, garden, terrace and breakfast in the piazza.

ristorante.title: Restaurant
ristorante.description: The Villa Madau restaurant in Pula serves traditional Sardinian cuisine with local ingredients: malloreddus, bottarga, grilled fish, seadas. Traditional Sardinian breakfast included.
ristorante.ogTitle: Restaurant | Villa Madau Hotel Pula Sardinia
ristorante.ogDescription: Traditional Sardinian cuisine with local produce. Pula, southern Sardinia.

servizi.title: Services
servizi.description: All services at Villa Madau Hotel in Pula: free WiFi, private parking, air conditioning, car rental, traditional Sardinian breakfast and tourist assistance.
servizi.ogTitle: Services | Villa Madau Hotel – Pula, Sardinia
servizi.ogDescription: All services at Villa Madau Hotel in Pula: free WiFi, private parking, air conditioning, car rental, traditional Sardinian breakfast and tourist assistance.

settimanaMare.title: A Week by the Sea – Villa Madau Pula Offer
settimanaMare.description: Seven days in southern Sardinia for two: double room with breakfast, lunch by the sea, a romantic dinner at Federico’s, beachfront sunbed and umbrella at Su Guventeddu. All included from €2,300 per couple.
settimanaMare.ogTitle: A Week by the Sea | Villa Madau Boutique Hotel
settimanaMare.ogDescription: 7 days of sea, sun and dolce vita in the heart of Pula. Room, breakfast, lunch by the sea and a romantic dinner: all included, a stone's throw from Chia and Tuerredda.
settimanaMare.ogAlt: Beachfront sunbed and umbrella at Su Guventeddu – Villa Madau offer

santEfisio.title: Sant'Efisio in Pula – Experience the Procession from Villa Madau
santEfisio.description: The Sant'Efisio procession departs from Cagliari on May 1st and arrives in Pula on May 2nd, right outside Villa Madau Boutique Hotel in the historic centre, facing the Church of San Giovanni.
santEfisio.ogTitle: Sant'Efisio in Pula | Villa Madau Boutique Hotel
santEfisio.ogDescription: Sardinia's most important procession passes right in front of your hotel. Book one of the six rooms with a view.
santEfisio.ogAlt: Villa Madau – room with a view of the Sant'Efisio procession

domusAntigas.title: Domus Antigas in Pula – Villa Madau at the Heart of the Event
domusAntigas.description: On March 15, 2026, the historic centre of Pula transforms with Domus Antigas. Villa Madau Boutique Hotel is at the heart of the event. Special offer: €100 with breakfast and late check-out.
domusAntigas.ogTitle: Domus Antigas 2026 | Villa Madau Boutique Hotel – Pula
domusAntigas.ogDescription: Experience Domus Antigas from inside the historic centre of Pula. Special Villa Madau offer: accommodation + breakfast + late check-out for €100.

pasqua.title: Easter in Pula – Villa Madau Boutique Hotel
pasqua.description: Spend the Easter weekend in Pula, Sardinia. Sea, nature, breakfast in the garden and Mediterranean cuisine at Villa Madau Boutique Hotel.
pasqua.ogTitle: Easter in Pula | Villa Madau Boutique Hotel – Sardinia
pasqua.ogDescription: Spend the Easter weekend in Pula, Sardinia. Sea, nature, breakfast in the garden and Mediterranean cuisine at Villa Madau Boutique Hotel.

gutturuMannu.title: Gutturu Mannu Park
gutturuMannu.description: Discover the Gutturu Mannu Regional Natural Park in Pula: the largest sclerophyll forest in the Mediterranean, home to the Sardinian deer, trails, waterfalls and unspoilt nature.
